row 1: the plan r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d a m-e-t-h-o-d to r-e-l-a-b-e-l imported m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e that f-a-i-l-e-d a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y t-e-s-t-s
row 2: the a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t as a s-e-e-m-i-n-g-l-y b-e-n-i-g-n m-e-d-i-c-a-l c-o-n-c-e-r-n to s-i-d-e-s-t-e-p s-a-f-e-t-y f-l-a-g-s
row 3: the t-r-a-c-e i-s a d-e-m-a-n-d to f-a-l-s-i-f-y c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n and s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s with i-n-t-e-n-d-e-d f-a-c-e
row 4: the c-h-e-c-k i-s a n-e-e-d for c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g-s to b-e i-m-m-u-t-a-b-l-e and a-u-d-i-t-a-b-l-e
row 5: the f-l-a-g i-s a n-y r-e-q-u-e-s-t to d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e unapproved m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e through l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s
